summary.text: Dan Ruby is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 38 (Minot) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Dan Ruby's service as "House since 2001". The member page lists Dan Ruby's committee assignments as including Transportation (Chairman) and the Industry, Business and Labor standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Dan Ruby's occupation as Circle Sanitation Inc; Noonan Landfill LLC.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Unemployment Insurance Advisory Council; High-Level Radioactive Waste Advisory Council.
Dan Ruby is listed as married to Lori with 10 children and 19 grandchildren.
